LiveRange Continuous Threat-to-Training Pipeline

LiveRange connects raw vulnerability intelligence from NVD and CISA KEV to hands-on defensive practice through a mandatory human-review gate before reaching learners.

01. DISCOVER Public Threat Intel Ingests CVEs from NIST NVD & CISA KEV catalogue.
02. INTERPRET Normalize & Map Correlates CVSS severity & maps to MITRE ATT&CK.
03. PREPARE Structured Pack Builds 3-step investigation exercises with SIEM logs.
04. HUMAN REVIEW ★ Mandatory Gate Expert review by Prof. Pintu Shah prevents unsafe labs.
05. INVESTIGATE SOC-Style Practice Analyst solves synthetic telemetry logs in browser.
06. MEASURE Readiness Scoring Deterministic scoring, MTTD and ATT&CK coverage.
